decision_cutoff: closed raw bar_end <= candidate intent; same-minute unclosed OHLC forbidden
candidate_grid: exact R1 original rows; no new minute grid
fill_contract: Frozen simulate_fill semantics: latch intent; iterate remaining saved comparison rows; require saved quoteAvailable and saved outcome.price at that minute; first such row fills; price is observed raw open*1.0005. No source open at t => retry on later candidate row; no forced fallback.
fill_basis_authority: saved Pattern-v2 outcomes.price and original R1 candidate quote/time manifests; verify raw open+5bps arithmetic but do not regenerate old Entry decisions
intrabar_order: open>=UP => UP_FIRST; open<=DOWN => DOWN_FIRST; otherwise H>=UP and L<=DOWN => ORDER_UNKNOWN; one touch => corresponding first; never invent H/L order
source_gap: missing scheduled raw minute before first barrier touch => DATA_UNAVAILABLE, not negative; known touch before gap retains status; NEITHER requires complete scheduled remainder and canonical full-session availability
regular_source_schedule: AM raw starts540..689; PM750..899 before2024-11-05, otherwise750..924; separate terminal auction starts690 and900/930. Exclude lunch and post2024-11-05 925..929 from continuous slots.
active_clock: inherit R1 continuous trading interval lengths [540,690] and [750,900/925]; terminal auction wall clock retained separately; clock endpoints are not relabeled to Geometry clock
first_touch_time: bar-start active elapsed is a lower-bound proxy; preserve bar-start and bar-end wall/active interval, no exact intrabar touch-time assertion
MAE_before_UP: include prior bars and current open known to precede touch; current touch-bar low order unknown unless open already above UP. Save optimistic/adverse bounds; exact field UNKNOWN when unequal.
MFE_before_DOWN: analogous preceding highs/open and touch-bar high bounds; exact field UNKNOWN when unequal
source_gate_required: C1 PASS; otherwise never create labels
arithmetic: saved canonical float64 P0 and saved OHLC; exact comparisons with no epsilon-imputation; independent Decimal audit checks first passage and reports any boundary mismatch
source_invalid_OHLC: DATA_UNAVAILABLE if an invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite OHLC bar precedes first passage; no invented ordering
